title: Measure gotcha trigger rates before promoting them
narrative: Scarce instruction components distinguish invariants from learned gotchas. Over-triggering is measurable, and promotion to active policy is explicit. Accepts inspiration requirement 8[^insp-r08].
implementation: `InstructionCatalog` / `InstructionComponent` track trigger, use, over/under rates; `promote` moves proposed gotchas to active after evaluation.
validation: Kind `instruction_gotcha_metrics`. Soft expects over_trigger recorded and active after promote.
